mostWorthwhile.text: Revising Moth's shortest route with residents' survey was worthwhile: it connected the AI's narrow distance objective to the practical constraints it missed.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two failed attempts were the least worthwhile; neither explained the prerequisite for using the survey or trolley.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the survey could not be combined with the map until Moth had first produced its stair-bound route.

arbitrary.text: That prerequisite felt somewhat arbitrary: the survey and map seemed useful together even before the shortest route existed.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be interested in seeing how the community uses its repairs and local knowledge to address the directory problem, though the hidden prerequisites made this chapter occasionally frustrating.
